Spot Prototype.name: Spot Prototype
Spot Prototype.description: The user takes a machine already at hand and spends a few minutes rebuilding it for a job it was never made for: a phone turned into a signal jammer, a delivery drone into a searchlight, a hand truck into a stretcher. The rebuilt device does that one job reliably for the rest of the scene, then is ruined. It cannot be done in the middle of a fight. Cost: none.
